signals.title: The patient differs across documents
signals.explanation: The patient's name is not the same in every document.

signals.title: The dates of stay differ across documents
signals.explanation: The admission or discharge date is not the same in every document.

signals.title: A bill is dated before the admission
signals.explanation: Hospital bill is dated 5 Jul 2026, before the admission on 10 Aug 2026.

signals.title: A bill is dated before the admission
signals.explanation: Itemized invoice is dated 6 Aug 2026, before the admission on 10 Aug 2026.

signals.title: Line items do not add up to the bill's total
signals.explanation: Itemized invoice states a total of INR 3,80,000.00, but its line items add up to INR 3,10,000.00.

signals.title: A line item is repeated on a bill
signals.explanation: Itemized invoice lists the same item at INR 45,000.00 2 times.

signals.title: The claimed amount is more than the bills
signals.explanation: The claim asks for INR 7,40,000.00, but the bills total INR 4,92,600.00.

signals.title: The claimed amount is above the sum insured
signals.explanation: The claim asks for INR 7,40,000.00, above the sum insured of INR 5,00,000.00.

signals.title: A very high amount per day of stay
signals.explanation: The claim asks for INR 7,40,000.00 a day, over 1 day of stay.

signals.title: The same file is in another claim
signals.explanation: Hospital bill is the same file as a document in another claim.

signals.title: An invoice number is reused at the same hospital
signals.explanation: Itemized invoice has the same invoice number as a bill from the same hospital in another claim.

signals.title: Statistically unusual compared with all baseline claims
signals.explanation: Isolation Forest scores this claim as more unusual than 99.82% of the synthetic baseline claims.

signals.title: Statistically unusual compared with similar claims
signals.explanation: Local Outlier Factor scores this claim as more unusual than 100% of the synthetic baseline claims.

signals.title: A bill closely matches a bill in another claim
signals.explanation: 5 of 7 line items on the hospital bill match, by description and amount, a bill from the same hospital in another claim.

signals.title: A similar claim shortly before or after
signals.explanation: Another claim for the same patient at the same hospital, 18 days apart, is for a similar amount.

signals.title: Statistically unusual compared with all baseline claims
signals.explanation: Isolation Forest scores this claim as more unusual than 99.84% of the synthetic baseline claims.

signals.title: Statistically unusual compared with similar claims
signals.explanation: Local Outlier Factor scores this claim as more unusual than 99.88% of the synthetic baseline claims.
